button-widget--toggle-layer.title: Toggle another layer
button-widget--toggle-layer.summary: A button that stays pressed shows a second layer of the map and hides it when released - here the state borders over a carbon map.

charts--line-from-csv.title: A line chart from a CSV file
charts--line-from-csv.summary: Loadcsv reads a table published next to the map, and afterCalc draws it in the panel - the CO2 emitted for each share of the forest cleared.

checkbox-widget--class-filters.title: Several switches, one filter
checkbox-widget--class-filters.summary: Each checkbox turns one class of the map on or off - here dry, moderate and wet places by annual rainfall.

combobox-widget--switch-map.title: Pick the map
combobox-widget--switch-map.summary: The list switches which map the layer shows - one layer, three maps of the Amazon, changed with changeLayers when the reader picks.

expression-function--two-maps.title: Two maps in one expression
expression-function--two-maps.summary: Name lists both maps, and each pixel brings both values - here forest biomass, kept only where the land is low.

file-source-layer--csv-points.title: Points from a CSV file
file-source-layer--csv-points.summary: Each row becomes a point at its coord_x / coord_y, with the other columns as its attributes, and close points are grouped into clusters.

file-source-layer--geojson-labels.title: A GeoJSON file, labelled
file-source-layer--geojson-labels.summary: Type geojsonurl loads a GeoJSON file by URL, and ${...} in the style writes an attribute of each feature on the map - here the regions of Belo Horizonte.

hoverpixel-widget--panel-readout.title: Values in the panel
hoverpixel-widget--panel-readout.summary: As the pointer moves, runOnHover writes the values of two maps under it into a label of the panel - here forest biomass and elevation.

slider-widget--coloured-track.title: Coloured track
slider-widget--coloured-track.summary: The slider's track is painted with colours by value, so the reader sees what each position means before moving it.

slider-widget--two-sliders.title: Two sliders, two maps
slider-widget--two-sliders.summary: One slider per map, and the layer keeps the places that pass both - here land that is both high and steep, in the Cerrado.

tutorial-01-first-map.title: Your first map
tutorial-01-first-map.summary: The whole query is one array with one layer definition - a published map, by its name.

tutorial-02-layers.title: Several layers
tutorial-02-layers.summary: Three maps in one query, each with its own title, opacity and starting state.

tutorial-03-other-servers.title: Maps from another server
tutorial-03-other-servers.summary: AddRemoteWMSServer registers a map server under a name of your choice, and each layer names it in source.

tutorial-04-source-types.title: Four kinds of source
tutorial-04-source-types.summary: A tile service (xyz), a published map (the default source), a calculated map (calculate) and features from a file (file), in one map.

tutorial-05-calculated-map.title: A calculated map with a control
tutorial-05-calculated-map.summary: A slider feeds the expression, and moving it computes the map again.

tutorial-06-groups.title: Groups
tutorial-06-groups.summary: ViewTitle makes a group of the top menu, elements holds its layers, and defaultProperties is shared by every layer inside.

tutorial-07-globals-and-functions.title: Globals and functions
tutorial-07-globals-and-functions.summary: SetQueryGlobalProperties declares the names the query shares, runNow runs once when the query is applied, and buttons call functions by name.

tutorial-08-extjsutils.title: The ExtjsUtils toolbox
tutorial-08-extjsutils.summary: The platform's helpers your code calls - here to talk to the reader, read a layer's legend and move the map.
